title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning at the RBAC v2 policy layer, tighten audit logging for KMS key usage, and add migration + policy validator. This improves data residency guarantees and auditability for enterprise customers.
description:
Motivation: Several enterprise customers and upcoming compliance assessments require strict enforcement of KMS region residency and stronger audit trails for key usage. Previous RBAC v2 policies allowed soft region hints which could be bypassed by operator error. This change makes region pinning an enforceable policy at request-authorization time and hardens audit logging for KMS operations (encrypt/decrypt/sign).

What this PR does: 1) Adds a new RBAC v2 policy predicate 'kms_region_pinning' and enforces it during policy evaluation when KMS-backed secrets or model keys are referenced. 2) Augments audit logging to include KMS key ARN, resolved region, effective policy id, and a residency_verdict field. 3) Adds a migration to reconcile existing app bindings that reference cross-region KMS keys and surfaces them to operators. 4) Introduces unit/integration tests and a policy-validator utility to detect non-compliant configs before deploy.

Implementation notes: - Policy evaluation: policies now run an early check for 'kms_region_pinning' and will return a DENY if the request's KMS key region does not match the allowed region set on the resource or org. This check is enforced for hosted and dedicated control planes; for private deployments the validator warns unless operator has explicitly disabled enforcement in config (controlled opt-out gate, see docs). - Audit logs: structured audit entry (json) added with fields {kms_key_arn, kms_region, policy_id, residency_verdict, operator_id}. Logs are emitted to the unified audit pipeline and include a deterministic correlation_id for the request. - Migration: a lightweight migration lists resources with cross-region keys and creates a staged report in /var/lib/redwood/migrations/kms_region_pinning_report_<timestamp>.json for operator review. Migration is idempotent.

Rollout plan: - Canary rollout on Dedicated regions (us-west-2, eu-west-1) with enforcement enabled for 10% of tenants. - Monitor audit metrics (audit.kms.residency_failures, audit.kms.enforced_count) and error budgets. - If residency_failures spike above threshold, automatic rollback to soft-audit mode for affected tenants is triggered and operators are paged.

Testing: Added unit tests for policy evaluator and integration tests that spin up a local KMS emulator to validate region resolution and audit log payloads. CI includes an integration stage that runs against the emulator.

Backwards compatibility: Non-breaking for most customers; enforcement is gated and default behavior for existing tenants remains audit-only for 2 weeks post-deploy. See release notes for timeline.

Related: ENG-4123 (policy runtime), SEC-2082 (customer audit requirements), SUP-901 (support escalation for cross-region key incident).
